conversation.text: You mentioned little support from your manager this week. What is happening?

Team lead is on Europe calls almost all day, so when I get stuck on billing disputes my messages wait until morning and cases sit. A 15-minute daily slot with them or a backup person to ask would really help.

Here is what I will tell HR: The employee reports delays in resolving billing disputes because the team lead is unavailable throughout the day. [MANAGER_SUPPORT] "Team lead is on Europe calls almost all day, so when I get stuck on billing disputes my messages wait until morning and cases sit."
